title: DesignSystemComponent:WorkflowReplayTimeline

_meta.purpose: Step-by-step execution replay, failure inspection, audit-chain correlation, and rollback/retry decision support for Workflow operators.

purpose: Step-by-step execution replay, failure inspection, audit-chain correlation, and rollback/retry decision support for Workflow operators.

accessibility.keyboard: timeline scrubber, step list, error cards, and export controls are keyboard reachable
accessibility.screen_reader: announces current step, status, elapsed time, retry eligibility, and audit row id

security_invariants: audit-chain row id is always visible for privileged actions
retry and rollback controls remain disabled until policy and idempotency checks pass
stale telemetry is rendered as blocking warning, never silently reused
